method: Built-in web search and page retrieval only. No merchant, model, scraping, or sourcing APIs called.
scope: Research handoff only. Live catalog JSON, graph, product assets, and deployment are unchanged.
verificationLimits: Search and open results can use indexed or cached pages; review date is not a guarantee of live inventory.
merchant_reports_stock means the retrieved page reports stock for a product or a stated variant, not every size.
variant_unverified must be checked before enabling checkout. Generic sold-out markup was not treated as proof that all variants are unavailable.
Totals exclude shipping, tax, duties, and discounts requiring codes. No Halloween delivery promise has been established.
Listed sizes are merchant labels, not a promise that all labels are currently available.

recommendedPicks.note: Closer visual and lower price than the catalog's black-denim default. Confirm selected size before checkout.

recommendedPicks.note: Silver western-style alternative. Page reports stock; selected size still needs checking. Uses sale price without coupon.

recommendedPicks.title: Reveal Kojima Bandanna — Blue
recommendedPicks.note: Cotton blue bandanna; less expensive than the silk wild rag. Merchant has a West Berkeley store; pickup stock is unconfirmed.

recommendedPicks.title: Velvet Cape with Embossed Red Lining
recommendedPicks.note: Page lists two in stock. Black velvet and red satin; hood replaces the concept's high collar. Cape only.

recommendedPicks.title: Bard Ruffled Shirt — White
recommendedPicks.note: Ruffled front and cuffs. Material is rayon, not cotton. Page reports stock; confirm size.

recommendedPicks.title: Gramercy Velvet Vest — Black
recommendedPicks.note: Black velvet double-breasted vest with satin back. Page reports stock; not every size is guaranteed.

recommendedPicks.title: Rockstar Black Buckle Pointed Toe Ankle Boots
recommendedPicks.note: Matches the original ankle-boot brief better than the $269.95 tall cavalry boots. Faux leather; confirm sizes.

recommendedPicks.title: Sunburst Magnetic Brooch — Silver
recommendedPicks.note: Silver-tone decorative brooch, not sterling silver. Page reports stock. Magnetic backing has a manufacturer pacemaker warning.

recommendedPicks.title: Luna Moth Wings Cape
recommendedPicks.note: Strong visual match, but made to order in Spain. Earlier indexed estimate was Nov 12–16; shipping shown separately around $53. Price varied between reads; confirm at checkout.

recommendedPicks.title: Unitard Black Activewear
recommendedPicks.note: Black sleeveless full-length recycled-tricot unitard. Final sale. Labels XS–5X are offered, but not all are proven available. Merchant has a San Francisco store.

recommendedPicks.title: Penny Blanc Ivory Faux Fur Collar
recommendedPicks.note: Ivory collar candidate. Page mixes sale/sold-out text with purchase controls; stock needs review. Dispatch is usually 4–7 business days.

recommendedPicks.title: Bug Antennae Headband
recommendedPicks.note: Page reports ready-to-ship stock. Black velvet-covered headband with bendable wire antennae.

recommendedPicks.title: Rockstar Black Buckle Pointed Toe Ankle Boots
recommendedPicks.note: Reusable black ankle-boot option; shares a product with the vampire. Prefer the shopper's existing comfortable dark shoes when suitable.

recommendedPicks.title: Bed Linen Flat Sheet Natural Undyed — Twin
recommendedPicks.note: Twin is 72 × 102 inches. The merchant page exposes available=true for this variant. Uncut sheet: draping and eye openings are DIY.

recommendedPicks.title: Willa Tee — No-bleach White
recommendedPicks.note: Organic-cotton base layer. Page lists $48 and purchase controls; confirm no-bleach white and selected size. Reuse an owned top where possible.

recommendedPicks.title: Hemp Pant — No-bleach White
recommendedPicks.note: Light base-layer candidate from the same merchant as the tee. Confirm selected color/size. Reuse existing light trousers where possible.

recommendedPicks.title: Captain Lace-Up Boot — Brown
recommendedPicks.note: Brown lace-up leather boot. Lower-priced catalog option than Grant Stone or HELM, though still a wardrobe purchase. Confirm size/width.

recommendedPicks.merchant: Needles 'n Pins Yarn Shoppe / JUL Designs
recommendedPicks.note: Merchant collection lists $18 and links this product. Stock is unconfirmed. Optional; test securely on the actual linen.

recommendedPicks.title: Adult Mushroom Hat
recommendedPicks.note: Handmade in California from cotton; adult red-and-white mushroom shape. Opened page showed $65; an older search excerpt showed $60.

recommendedPicks.title: Dahlia Puff Sleeve Top — Natural/Cream
recommendedPicks.note: Cream cotton puff sleeves and embroidery. Merchant search excerpt lists $58, XS–L, and add-to-cart; direct rendering is incomplete. Replaces Snag's preorder blouse.

recommendedPicks.title: Classic Brown Corduroy Overalls
recommendedPicks.note: Merchant page embeds one available Small; M/L/XL are unavailable. Useful budget option with very narrow size coverage.

recommendedPicks.note: Observed sale price $37.60, previously $46.99. Page offers add-to-cart; size selection can change to preorder, so confirm the chosen size.

recommendedPicks.note: Brown lace-up boot candidate; premium wardrobe purchase. Listed $210. Confirm selected size rather than relying on generic stock widgets.
